resources.string: The camera is handled by the head unit and always stays on top: SailDash never touches it. This only changes the volume of music from apps (Spotify, CarPlay through AutoKit, NewPipe, USB). On some head units the radio and Bluetooth music go through the sound chip and don\'t follow Android\'s volume: for those, use the factory \"reverse volume\" option if your head unit has it.
Music when you shift into reverse
Bring the volume back when leaving reverse
It goes back to what it was 2 seconds after you leave reverse. If you change it while reversing, it stays the way you left it.
Play some music and tap Test: it sounds like reverse for 3 seconds and comes back.
Your head unit has a fixed Android volume, so SailDash can\'t change it. Use the factory \"reverse volume\" option.
How SailDash knows you\'re in reverse
I don\'t know yet when you shift into reverse. Teach me once with the car on: tap Learn reverse, shift into reverse and leave it there a few seconds.
Noted how everything is without reverse. Now shift into reverse and leave it there a few seconds: the camera will cover the screen, that\'s normal. %1$d s left.
Got the change! Keep it in reverse a moment longer… (%1$d s)
Several settings changed; pick the reverse one (if it doesn\'t work, learn again):
Done! Now I know when you\'re in reverse · %1$s
Nothing changed: your head unit doesn\'t tell apps when reverse is engaged (or you didn\'t shift in time). Try again; if it stays the same, use the factory \"reverse volume\" option.
